name: Grid-Based Game Competitions Benchmark
description: An extensible benchmark for evaluating large language models through grid-based games like Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, and Gomoku. It measures LLMs' abilities in rule comprehension and strategic thinking by simulating matches and analyzing performance across different prompt types.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark with some interest for strategic reasoning evaluation, but not a widely established standard in the broader LLM community.
notes: Includes detailed data files and leaderboard rankings; evaluates LLMs on games they were not specifically trained for.
